title: TritonSim Hardware Configuration
description: Schema for defining NPU/accelerator hardware parameters
$comment: Standard JSON has no // comments. Property descriptions in this schema are the canonical field comments for hardware configuration files.

$schema.description: Relative path to this JSON Schema; used by editors and offline validators, not by the runtime cost formulas.

version.description: Version of this configuration data, not the silicon generation.

description.description: Human-readable scope, evidence boundary, and usage warning for this concrete target configuration.

target.description: Canonical compiler target used to validate referenced measurement assets

microbenchmark_profile.description: Path, relative to this hardware config, to the shared model-neutral measurement catalog

clock.description: Device-compute clock configuration. SYS_CNT is a separate clock domain stored in the shared microbenchmark profile.

cycles_per_us.description: Human-readable frequency_ghz × 1000. The current C++ loader derives timing from frequency_ghz and does not consume this scalar.

description.description: Meaning and clock-domain boundary of this object.

memory_spaces.description: Named addressable memory hierarchy. Names are referenced by compute units and data movers.

additionalProperties.description: One named memory space and its capacity, bandwidth, latency, purpose, and optional per-field provenance.

type.description: Memory category: off-chip, shared on-chip, local on-chip, or register-file-like storage.

size_gb.description: Capacity label in GB; the current loader multiplies by 1024^3 bytes, so its effective interpretation is GiB-like.

size_mb.description: Capacity label in MB; the current loader multiplies by 1024^2 bytes.

size_kb.description: Capacity label in KB; the current loader multiplies by 1024 bytes.

bandwidth_tbps.description: Theoretical or model bandwidth in decimal 10^12 byte/s; converted to byte/device-compute-cycle.

bandwidth_gbps.description: Theoretical or model bandwidth in decimal 10^9 byte/s; converted to byte/device-compute-cycle.

latency_cycles.description: Fixed access-latency prior in device-compute cycles.

description.description: Purpose, source boundary, and calibration status of this memory space.

source.description: Optional source shared by the complete memory-space record.

compute_units.description: Named compute engines and their declared topology, peak rates, legal types, and memory-space contract.

additionalProperties.description: One named compute engine and its physical width, peak rates, supported operations, and memory-space contract.

description.description: Purpose and evidence boundary of this compute unit.

tflops_fp16.description: Declared FP16 peak arithmetic rate in TFLOP/s.

tflops_fp32.description: Declared FP32 peak arithmetic rate in TFLOP/s.

tflops_int8.description: Declared INT8 peak operation rate; the legacy field name says TFLOPS although TOPS is the more precise unit.

tile_m.description: Fallback Cube tile M when no dtype-specific fractal shape is found.

tile_n.description: Fallback Cube tile N when no dtype-specific fractal shape is found.

tile_k.description: Fallback Cube reduction dimension K when no dtype-specific fractal shape is found.

width_elements.description: Nominal SIMD element count, traditionally expressed for the reference dtype; do not use as a dtype-independent lane count.

width_bytes.description: Physical SIMD vector width in bytes; lane count equals width_bytes × 8 / element_bits.

input_spaces.description: Names of memory spaces read by this compute engine.

output_space.description: Name of the memory space written by this compute engine.

compute_space.description: Local memory space in which this engine executes its arithmetic.

supported_ops.description: Operation categories declared as supported by this engine.

supported_dtypes.description: Data types declared as supported by this engine.

source.description: Optional source shared by the complete compute-unit record.

data_movers.description: Named hardware transfer paths between memory spaces.

additionalProperties.description: One named data-mover path, including its endpoints, modeled bandwidth, burst constraints, and fused capabilities.

dst_spaces.description: Multiple destination memory-space names; when present, the loader replaces dst_space with this list.

bandwidth_gbps.description: Modeled transfer bandwidth in decimal GB/s.

max_burst_bytes.description: Maximum bytes in one modeled burst.

alignment_bytes.description: Required or efficient byte alignment for this transfer path.

supports_accumulate.description: Whether accumulation may be fused into this transfer.

supports_cast.description: Whether type conversion may be fused into this transfer.

pipeline.description: Pipeline path declarations and intended overlap relationships.

hardware_units.description: Map from hardware-unit name to its pipeline path and overlap capability. The current C++ loader does not consume this nested map.

parallelism.description: Intended inter-path and intra-path overlap relationships. The current nested representation is not consumed by the C++ loader.

performance_model.description: Documentary analytical formulas. The current C++ loader does not interpret or execute this block.

description.description: Human-readable status and intended meaning of this formula.

formula.description: Human-readable expression; it is not evaluated by the loader.

include_latency.description: Documents whether the conceptual formula includes fixed latency; not consumed from this block.

calibration.description: Absolute-model priors, evidence notes, and target-specific calibration parameters.

description.description: Origin, inheritance, and recalibration requirements for this target profile.

startup_latencies.description: Startup-cycle priors. The current JSON loader does not consume this object; getters use C++ defaults.

description.description: Consumption status or provenance shared by the startup-latency fields.

vector_startup_cycles.description: Vector pipeline startup prior in device-compute cycles.

mte2_startup_cycles.description: MTE2 startup prior in device-compute cycles.

mte3_startup_cycles.description: MTE3 startup prior in device-compute cycles.

cube_startup_cycles.description: Cube engine startup prior in device-compute cycles.

fixpipe_startup_cycles.description: FixPipe startup prior in device-compute cycles.

notes.description: Free-form calibration rationale retained for human review; not consumed by the loader.

vector_op_cycles_per_vec_instruction.description: Legacy cycles-per-vector-instruction priors. This is the only calibration sub-object currently parsed from JSON.

description.description: Consumption status or provenance shared by these operation-cycle priors.

simple_ops_add_sub_mul_etc.description: Shared legacy cycle prior for simple vector add, sub, mul, and cast instructions.

notes.description: Free-form calibration rationale retained for human review; not consumed as an operation cost.

scalar_overhead.description: Observed scalar/compute ratios retained as evidence; the current JSON loader does not consume them.

description.description: Source and interpretation shared by the scalar-overhead fields.

aiv_scalar_to_vec_ratio_steady_state.description: Steady-state AIV scalar cost relative to vector cost.

aic_scalar_to_mac_ratio_steady_state.description: Steady-state AIC scalar cost relative to Cube MAC cost.

aiv_vec_ratio_observed.description: Observed fraction of AIV time attributed to vector work.

aiv_scalar_overhead_factor.description: Non-vector overhead factor in total ≈ vector × (1 + factor).

parallelism.description: Declared physical core counts. The current JSON loader does not consume them; current getters still use C++ defaults.

description.description: Source of the declared core counts.

pipe_barrier.description: Barrier-overhead prior. The current JSON loader does not consume this object.

description.description: Calibration source and interpretation of the barrier prior.

cycles_per_inner_iteration.description: Modeled AIC/AIV pipe-barrier cost per inner iteration.

wave_overhead.description: Multi-wave overhead evidence and recalibration warning; not parsed by the current loader.

description.description: Source and validity boundary of the wave-overhead model.

stages.description: Ordered data-mover and compute-unit names in this path.

description.description: Human-readable role of this pipeline path.

fully_pipelined.description: Declares steady-state stage overlap. The current C++ JSON loader does not consume this field.

pipeline_hardware_unit.description: Pipeline membership and overlap declaration for one named hardware unit.

path.description: Execution path to which this unit belongs.

can_overlap.description: Whether this unit is declared able to overlap with independent hardware units.

pipeline_overlap_group.description: Named overlap relationships within or between pipeline paths.

description.description: Human-readable interpretation of this group of overlap flags.

additionalProperties.description: Whether the hardware paths or stages named by this key may execute concurrently.

field_metadata.description: Per-field provenance and confidence without changing the scalar field shape expected by the runtime loader.

field_metadata_entry.description: Meaning, provenance, and confidence attached to one scalar field while preserving that field's loader-compatible numeric type.

description.description: Meaning and scope of the concrete field value.

source.description: Specification, configuration, baseline, or measurement from which the value came.

confidence.description: Evidence confidence for this concrete value.

formula_entry.description: Documentary formula entry; current C++ code does not evaluate this expression.

description.description: Human-readable status and intended meaning of this formula.

base_cycles.description: Nominal cycles per atomic unit in the documented formula.
